dedupe_keys.name: zindi and itu ai for good beam level traffic data hourly throughput prb use and users for 2 880 beams at 30 base stations

description: The Spatio-Temporal Beam-Level Traffic Forecasting Challenge (July to October 2024) was run on Zindi with the ITU AI for Good programme. Contents: four CSV files of hourly radio network performance metrics for 2,880 beams across 30 base stations (3 cells of 32 beams each) over five weeks: downlink throughput volume (DLThpVol, the forecasting target), downlink throughput time, physical resource block (PRB) utilisation and user count (measurement report number). Producer: ITU AI for Good challenge on Zindi; the operator source and location are not named on the pages read. Coverage: one anonymised network, five weeks, hourly. Format and access: CSV files and a starter notebook downloaded from Zindi after creating a free account and joining the challenge. Licence: challenge data may be accessed, used and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 according to the challenge rules. Caveats: short period and anonymised geography, so the data suit forecasting method tests, not network planning of a known place. Simulation uses: mobile traffic forecasting for capacity planning and energy saving, and load inputs for digital network twins. Related records: data-itu-5g-base-station-energy-consumption-challenge and data-zindi-green-telecom-site-energy-solar-grid-outage-diesel.
